impact: Wider Gulf escalation near Hormuz adds an oil risk premium and a headwind for risk assets already hit by a hawkish Fed.
summary: Iran targeted Patriot batteries and launch platforms at Ali Al-Salem Air Base in Kuwait and launched several attacks on Bahrain, a day after US strikes on a missile site on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz. Kuwait and Bahrain say they intercepted the attacks; Bahrain has now faced four Iranian attacks in six days. Saudi Arabia and the GCC condemned the escalation.
title: Iran strikes US air base in Kuwait and targets in Bahrain after US hit on Qeshm Island
